summary: Raised from MPI-630's close-out, approved by Fabio. De-flake flow-reuse-opens-without-model.spec.js — the stub loses a race

Started. Writer confirmed: js/shell.js:1538 registers the only models:checked -> s_installedModelIds writer synchronously at boot step 7, so a refresh landing inside the spec 80ms deferred window overwrites the stub. Fix is to make the stub authoritative for the test lifetime, not to widen the sleep.

Fixed. The spec re-applies its stub from a models:checked listener registered AFTER shell's (js/shell.js:1538 is the only writer of s_installedModelIds, and it registers synchronously at boot step 7, so the order is deterministic); Events fans out over an insertion-ordered Set synchronously, so a backend refresh is overwritten inside its own emit, before the deferred read in openFlowFromReuse's setTimeout(0) can see it. The 80ms sleep is unchanged, per the card. Reproduced deterministically instead of waited for: the spec now emits models:checked with an empty set inside the window - exactly what a runner with no weights does - which fails the test every run with the re-stub disabled and passes with it (verified both ways; --repeat-each=5 all green). Full desktop suite 40 passed. Only the spec file changed, so no app behaviour moved.
